versions.changelog:
AliWay v1.0.1 adds diverse strategic writing frameworks, a style library, and richer examples.

- 增加并详解 4 大文档框架（战略判断型/组织动员型/复盘反思型/愿景布道型），确保输出不再千篇一律
- 引入“阿里土话 102 式”素材库，支持原生态阿里味表达，强调土话点睛而非堆砌
- 新增开篇手法库，丰富文档开场方式，提升叙事吸引力
- 扩展修辞模式、语气特征与“道法术器”解读，强调思维方式与格局穿透力
- 更新质量检查清单和禁忌项，鼓励多样化结构和内在逻辑创新
- 移除 skill-card.md，无功能影响

Initial release of aliway skill — strategic document writing in the "阿里味" (AliWay) style.

- Elevates any technical document to an Alibaba P10-level strategic narrative using the "道法术器" (Dao-Method-Technique-Tool) logic framework.
- Specifically designed for scenarios requiring 阿里味, 阿里风格, P10战略, CTO视角, or keywords like 见自己见天地见众生, 使命愿景, 终局思维, 顶层设计.
- Provides detailed writing structure: self-reflection, macro environment, user perspective, layered reasoning, and actionable metrics.
- Includes guidance on authentic 阿里修辞 (Ali-style rhetoric), required tone, and a robust self-checklist for quality control.
- Enforces clear distinctions between strategic narrative and mere technical description.
